think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s domain and what the value controls. 2) Check whether the knob defines any sentinel/special values (e.g., 0, -1) that switch the behavior to a qualitatively different mode (such as disabling a feature) rather than just scaling it. 3) If such sentinel values exist, classify as a special knob and record the special value(s); otherwise classify as not special.
